Paired branch for phase 1 of the default-workspace-template's chat-agent-split plan (`docs/system/blueprint/chat-agent-split/plan-chat-agent-split.md` there): every in-workspace sender messages a chat through the chat app by chat id, with `mngr message` as the backoff. No code in this repository changes; the branch exists so the template change runs this repository's test suites too.
